lines.1: When someone's got the looks to begin with, they really can pull off anything.
lines.3: A parrot flew in from who knew where.
lines.4: 「Oooh! Terrible!! What're you planning to do with this many maids at your beck and call? Send one my way!」
lines.6: 「Does this maid serve verbal abuse instead of tea? Even I can't hide my surprise at such arrogance!」
lines.8: 「Three-day weekend, so she's doing some sleeping in bed.」
lines.9: 「I alone flew over because I was worried about the students.」
lines.10: ...I was starting to forget which one of them was the teacher.
lines.11: 「Whatever. Ignore the parrot and let's get started.」
lines.12: 「Nice way of taking charge. Just what I'd expect of my rival.」
lines.13: 「Since when am I a bird's rival!!!」
lines.14: 「Oh, there she goes getting mad! People like her are the type to order their men on the battlefield, 'All troops charge! Fear no death!'」
lines.15: 「Easy, easy, Tsuchinaga-san. Here, have a look at this bird encyclopedia.」
lines.16: 「Hoh. This female parrot's got some nice wings on her.」
